subject.title: fix(webhooks): keep routes cold when SecretRefs are unavailable

question: Should webhook SecretRefs stop supporting request-time rotation and require Gateway reload or restart so all authentication uses the owner-isolated startup snapshot?
rationale: Both behaviors are defensible: snapshot-only access matches repository architecture and improves diagnostics, but it intentionally removes a documented shipped rotation capability and adds operator action during secret rotation.

options.title: Adopt snapshot-only rotation
options.body: Accept reload or restart as the webhook SecretRef rotation contract and retain the manifest-owned route isolation implemented here.

options.title: Preserve live rotation
options.body: Add a lifecycle-owned route refresh mechanism that preserves no-restart rotation without resolving secrets on public requests.

recommendation.title: Adopt snapshot-only rotation
recommendation.body: Accept reload or restart as the webhook SecretRef rotation contract and retain the manifest-owned route isolation implemented here.
